name: Nonlinear
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one ultra-refined original desktop portfolio webpage screenshot, 1536x1024 landscape, edge-to-edge flat digital UI.
Primary request: An exceptionally original full-stack AI software engineer portfolio for Zohaib Haider, concept NONLINEAR. The WEBSITE IS AN EXPLORABLE INFINITE DESIGN CANVAS: the projects, diagrams and annotations are the entire composition. Editorial art direction meets spatial software, precise, beautiful, mature and advanced.
Composition: absolutely NO two-column hero, NO text block on left with image on right, NO central standard landing-page hero. Full viewport pale cool-gray drafting canvas. A tiny fixed masthead across top: 'ZH / ZOHAIB HAIDER' left, 'FULL-STACK + AI ENGINEER' center, 'INDEX ↗' right. The canvas is zoomed out enough to show several intriguing clusters with large breathing spaces; it continues beyond the edges. Three asymmetrically arranged clusters form a diagonal journey across the FULL WIDTH: a wide actual software booking interface at upper-left/mid-left labeled '01 / DSP — BOOKING SYSTEM'; an exploded visual flow of elegant orange circles, thin graphite lines and tiny interface fragments through center labeled '02 / INTELLIGENCE IN MOTION'; a larger operations dashboard at lower-right labeled '03 / PDE — MULTI-TENANT PLATFORM'. Across the map small neatly drawn curved orange connecting paths with smart routing, rare arrowheads and small annotation numbers. Tiny black-and-white architecture sketches, one vertical orange typographic tag, a narrow code snippet, and one beautiful brushed-aluminum organic knot as a physical sculptural canvas artifact. These details should be deliberate and curated, not cluttered. Major project previews look like beautiful real product interfaces, crisp and legible. On canvas at upper-center a small standalone typographic manifesto 'Follow the work.' in stunning 68px serif, integrated into negative space, no paragraph under it. Small sticky annotation 'Every interface has a system behind it.' lower-left. Bottom fixed translucent slim toolbar centered with 'DRAG TO EXPLORE', zoom minus and plus, '64%', and 'RESET VIEW'. Bottom-left a restrained minimap, bottom-right 'LET’S BUILD SOMETHING ↗'. Accents safety orange #FF5A24, ink black, frosted silver, soft gray #F0F0ED. Fine noise almost invisible, superb hairline strokes and spacing, unusually thoughtful canvas UI.
Constraints: original full-viewport nonlinear navigable portfolio design, not a dashboard, not a generic node editor or sitemap, no rounded bento tiles, no pastel gradient hero, no fake metrics or testimonials, no watermarks. The whole canvas IS the experience. Content must look sophisticated and meaningful, with dramatic hierarchy and enough breathing room. Exact name spelled Zohaib Haider. Static concept of an interactive site.

name: Aperture
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity art-directed desktop portfolio webpage screenshot, 1536x1024 landscape, actual UI flat and edge-to-edge, not a monitor or a presentation.
Primary request: Design APERTURE, a stunning cinematic portfolio for Zohaib Haider, full-stack AI software engineer. Think interactive cinema exhibition for software: unusually immersive, experimental, beautiful, sophisticated and usable. This must feel like a unique website opening frame.
Composition: full viewport obsidian black cinema canvas. An enormous dimensional silver folded-ribbon monogram shaped loosely like an abstract Z, liquid brushed-chrome and black smoked glass, hangs at the EXACT CENTER, stretching from 20% to 76% screen height, with deeply considered gallery lighting and subtle amber edge reflections. Thin oversized outlined typography 'BUILD' spans almost full screen width behind and partly occluded by the sculpture, embedded within composition. Across the lower middle, overlaid in front of the sculpture, exceptionally beautiful enormous white serif/sans typographic contrast: 'Ideas into / living software.' centered, with deliberate linebreak, no content column at either side. It must remain readable through contrast. Top nav is sparse: 'ZOHAIB HAIDER' at top-left, 'FULL STACK / AI / SYSTEMS' top-center, menu icon and 'LET’S TALK ↗' top-right. At left edge a vertical chapter progress label '01 — SELECTED WORK'. At right edge tiny 'DRAG TO ROTATE' with orbit gesture glyph. At bottom a wide sophisticated horizontal cinematic filmstrip occupying 17% of height, four project frames with real-looking software UI miniatures: '01 DSP', '02 PDE', '03 AI EXPERIMENTS', '04 ENGINEERING NOTES', one selected frame bordered soft amber, all tiny refined labels with thin dividing lines and a small film-editor scrub marker. A quiet mini caption just above filmstrip 'A portfolio in four chapters.' and arrows to move horizontally. No paragraph or standard CTA button in the hero. One tiny 'ENTER CHAPTER ↗' floating pill on bottom-center of sculpture. Almost monochrome with one restrained burnt-amber accent, stunning sculptural metal material, luminous typography and dark cinematic depth, controlled not flashy.
Constraints: NO split left-text/right-art layout; NO conventional landing page sections; NO generic glowing orb, AI brain, robot, sci-fi HUD, dashboard panels, starfield, or excessive glow. Entire screen is ONE coherent cinematic composition. No giant fake stats or logos, no watermark. Original premium website concept, crisp UI, striking visual hierarchy and polished physical rendering.

name: Cabinet of Systems
prompt:

Primary request: Design CABINET OF SYSTEMS, a radical yet beautiful software engineer portfolio for Zohaib Haider. A digital specimen archive with tactile industrial materials. Actual products become numbered artifacts and technical curiosities in a curator's collection. A totally different composition from a standard portfolio.
Composition: Full-width bold acidic chartreuse #DFFF00 header region occupying top 28% of canvas. Top thin black masthead 'ZOHAIB HAIDER' left, 'FULL-STACK + AI SOFTWARE ENGINEER' center, 'CONTACT ↗' right. Beneath it massive condensed black editorial typography across full width: 'ENGINEERED. / NOT ORDINARY.' tightly arranged in two lines with the second right-aligned, one subtle industrial cut through a letter. Small side marker 'COLLECTION 001—006'. Below the header: a HUGE open flat-lay archival tray across full viewport width, warm silver aluminum base and precisely arranged specimen objects seen from directly above with soft contact shadows. Three long irregular museum mounting channels spanning the width, not generic floating rounded cards. In the tray: a polished clear acrylic plate holding a beautiful actual booking calendar screenshot with label '001 / DSP — BOOKING + PAYMENTS'; a matte black rectangular data cartridge with orange indexing tab holding a small system graph marked '002 / AI WORKFLOWS'; a miniature folded screen showing an operations table labeled '003 / PDE — MULTI-TENANCY'; an etched glass slab with a delicate neural node constellation; a chrome API connector sculpture; a small booklet 'FIELD NOTES'. Fixed tiny bottom toolbar 'VIEW: OBJECTS / INDEX' and '6 OBJECTS / SELECT TO INSPECT'. Background silver warm white, black, bright chartreuse and rare vermilion. Strong type, tactile glass-metal objects, exact small labels, very premium industrial editorial design.

Product previews are design placeholders, no fabricated outcomes or metrics, no watermark.

name: Orbit
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one incredibly polished desktop portfolio website design screenshot, 1536x1024 landscape, full-bleed flat actual UI.
Primary request: Design ORBIT, a spatial portfolio for Zohaib Haider, full-stack AI software engineer. An elegant interactive circular exhibition of shipped software. Advanced aesthetic interaction design, like a contemporary digital installation with precision-product UI.
Composition: ONE dominant centered radial composition across the WHOLE screen, no two-column layout and no conventional hero. Bone-white backdrop #E8E6E1, charcoal and midnight navy typography. A gorgeous huge elliptical orbit rendered as a delicate polished chrome track at a shallow isometric tilt fills 85% of width, extending slightly beyond left and right borders. Around the track FLOAT FOUR genuinely beautiful detailed software display planes at different physical angles and depths, resembling fine freestanding acrylic museum display plaques: booking dashboard at front lower-center, multi-tenant operations interface at right-back, AI request workflow at upper-center, developer notes at left-back. Distinct sizes, convincing spatial relationship and rich soft shadows. Thin chrome satellites/etched markers on rail, not colored planet balls. A beautifully designed clear central pedestal carries a tiny minimal dark glass object like a stack of computing wafers. Directly centered over the orbit's open negative space, typographic name 'ZOHAIB / HAIDER' in massive elegant black modern grotesk with exceptionally precise tracking, title integrated into space, no long paragraphs. Below the name a small centered 'FULL STACK + AI SOFTWARE ENGINEER'. Upper-left micro navigation 'ZH / ORBIT 01'; upper center toggles 'EXPLORE / INDEX'; top-right 'AVAILABLE FOR COLLABORATION ↗'. A sophisticated compact bottom-center orbit dial with curved tick marks, '01 / DSP', previous/next controls and 'OPEN PROJECT ↗'. Bottom-left a line 'Products, connected by thoughtful engineering.' Bottom-right 'SCROLL TO ORBIT' with tiny circular arrow. A single saffron-orange active marker and tiny orange project number accents, otherwise polished metallic neutrals. Type hierarchy is unusually beautiful. Artful selective depth of field but UI text crisp.
Constraints: full viewport centered circular spatial navigation, NO text left image right, NO generic ball/sphere/brain or planets/space imagery, NO HUD, no purple gradients, no standard rounded card grid, no fake performance numbers, no watermark. Products and interface details must be primary artifacts, not just abstract decoration. Looks genuinely implementable as a premium interactive web portfolio.

name: Off Grid
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one full-fidelity original desktop portfolio website screenshot, 1536x1024 landscape, edge-to-edge digital interface, no device frame.
Primary request: Design OFF GRID, a bold experimental typographic collage portfolio for Zohaib Haider, full-stack AI software engineer. Award-caliber art direction with an unconventional dense-yet-controlled composition, confident indie software-maker identity, amazing aesthetic taste. Inspired by contemporary Swiss exhibition graphics, concrete poetry and experimental digital magazines, but create an entirely original composition.
Composition: warm pale peach #F2E3D3 canvas, charcoal black, electric cobalt blue, tiny hot-orange accent. Massive condensed black surname 'HAIDER' spans the ENTIRE WIDTH of screen starting 18% down; letters interact with the content and are partially covered by project material. Smaller but still large 'ZOHAIB' sits above left, with a tiny monospace 'FULL-STACK + AI ENGINEER' situated precisely inside an open counter/space between typographic elements. The lower half is an art-directed collage of four real-looking project windows and graphic objects deliberately overlapping the oversized typography: a sharp landscape booking dashboard at -6 degree angle on left; a cobalt blue vertical project title strip near center with 'SYSTEMS WITH CHARACTER'; a large wide multi-tenant table UI at +4 degree angle toward center-right; a small high-contrast code excerpt in a dark terminal overlay near bottom-center. One tactile polished chrome typographic asterisk intertwines with a thin orange swooping line between windows. Small hand-drawn orange circle annotates one screen. Typography and windows span left-to-right; there must be no empty half devoted to text. Above right, an original circular typographic menu with WORK / PLAY / NOTES / ABOUT around an open center, super crisp, not a badge. Tiny top utility row 'SELECTED WORK / 2026' left and 'LET’S MAKE IT HAPPEN ↗' right. Bottom very clean fixed navigation strip with project index '01 DSP / 02 PDE / 03 AI LAB', an understated toggle 'ARRANGE / EXPLORE', and a small clear 'OPEN PROJECT ↗' action. All tilted screen text intentionally small but credible and aligned. The overall collage has one obvious central focal point and clean negative-space pockets. Sophisticated tension, extraordinary typography, unexpected composition, beautifully tactile surfaces, visual rhythm.
Constraints: NO two-column hero, NO left-text/right-image, NO generic bento, no corporate SaaS look, no purple gradients, no dark neon tech wallpaper, no stock people, no fake testimonials or metrics. Must look like a mature experimental PORTFOLIO WEBSITE with readable navigation and actual project previews, not a concert poster. No watermark.
